items: Swap the furnace filter; check it monthly
Vacuum vents and keep returns unblocked
Keep 3 ft clear around furnace & heater
cta_head: Let MyHome handle all four for you.
cta_sub: Call or text 317-440-9258 or ask about Essential Care, $39/mo.
